paragraphs.text: Forenzad was a wojek Section Commander of the Third Section in 9999 Z.C., present during Kos' promotion hearing on Ravnica .

He was a bald, dark man with two white shocks of hair behind his softly pointed ears. He was a former patrolling officer who had worked his way through the ranks during the years. He was named for his single elvish ancestor.
Sometime before the Decamillennial , Forenzad was killed and replaced by a lupul , a fact that was revealed during the Decamillennial .
